QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_51

question.text: Ananya Alpha Fund (Cat III) has Gross NAV of INR 80 crore at year-end. Management fee is 1.75% (excl. GST 18%). What is the management fee CHARGED TO THE FUND (inclusive of GST)?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Management fee = 1.75% × 80 crore = INR 1.40 crore. Adding 18% GST: 1.40 × 1.18 = INR 1.6520 crore charged to fund. **The Trap:** Option A ignores GST. Option C is a round miscalculation. Option B is off by 10×. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-B tests identical calcs; XIX-A for Cat I/II on committed capital. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When presenting fee math to LPs, always show both ex-GST and incl-GST numbers. LPs compare across funds; GST presentation inconsistency creates false comparisons.
